nyquist_and_aliasing.aliasing_finding: Because phone accelerometer is sampled at only 10 Hz without verifiable analog anti-aliasing prior to digitization, the primary engine mechanical rotation (13.33 Hz at 800 RPM) and 4-cylinder firing pulse (26.67 Hz) both mathematically alias directly into the observable band at 3.33 Hz. This explains why a sharp spectral energy concentration is observed in Band 3 (2–5 Hz) during standstill.
